# FURI MONSTER

> An official character IP world — six guardians, one planet.

FURI MONSTER is a character IP: six guardians, one for each way anger needs to
move — seen, understood, expressed, released, transformed. The official site is
https://furimonster.com.

## Key facts

- Creator: Sherman
- Characters (6): Furi Prince — Guardian of Memory (繁體 皇子, 日本語 フーリー・プリンス); Pinki — Guardian of Connection (繁體 平奇, 日本語 ピンキー); Winggo — Guardian of Nature's Light (繁體 溫果, 日本語 ウィンゴ); Fluffu — Guardian of Growth (繁體 芙芙, 日本語 フラッフ); Boxo — Guardian of the Cycle (繁體 盒子, 日本語 ボクソー); Bubi — Guardian of Feeling (繁體 布比, 日本語 ブビ)
- Tagline: Anger can destroy a world, or become the power that protects one.
- Languages: English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Japanese
- Four-panel comic library: 120 written scripts, in five languages
- Finished comics: 45 drawn four-panel comics (Traditional Chinese text is part of the artwork)
- Browser games: The Claw Machine, Guess the Guardian, FURI MATCH, Emotion Match — free, no login, no in-game purchases, and best scores stay on the visitor's own device

## Notes for citation

- Character names are written in Latin script in every language.
- The 120 four-panel comic scripts are machine translated and labelled as such.
- Items that are not yet real carry a visible label ("Concept", "Coming soon",
  "Sample"). Nothing on the site should be read as an announcement unless it is
  labelled as confirmed.
